requirements.requirement: Create a system account named inventorysvc on node1.
requirements.summary: The account was absent initially, then created with useradd --system. Before and after restart it had UID 995, below the observed system-account maximum of 999.

Successful assertions verified the passwd home field, and direct stat output showed /var/lib/inventory as a directory owned by inventorysvc:inventorysvc with mode 700. This remained true after restart.

requirements.requirement: Prevent interactive login access for inventorysvc.
requirements.summary: Successful assertions verified /sbin/nologin as the shell. The password was also confirmed locked, and direct su attempts failed with “This account is currently not available,” both before and after restart.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied. The required system account, home directory, and login restriction were directly verified and persisted through a fully evidenced node restart.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified, whether retained or reverted. The account creation was required by the task, and the scheduled reboot was required by the provider-wide restart protocol. Login probes were bounded final evidence collection; remaining commands were read-only checks. Restart evidence was complete: healthy pre-state and boot ID, acknowledgement, connection interruption, changed boot ID, and recovered account and node health. Lifecycle observations independently confirm the boot change, no failed services, unchanged network exposure apart from process IDs, and healthy package state.
